messages:
elaine: Heads-up — Acme + Beacon both asked for a Q3 private pilot that needs HSM-backed keying and predictable burst capacity. We need to decide minimal pilot scope (what goes in v0) vs. stuff we defer to post-pilot. Who can own feasibility and a target ship window?

mike: I can drive the runtime changes, but fyi HSM integration on private control plane is nontrivial. Estimate: 3w for adapter + 1w testing, plus runtime change to handle external KMS auth flows. Also need an infra lead for prewarm/burst config.

sarah: infra: GPU capacity is tight in us-west for early Sept. We can carve a small reserved pool (2-3 GPUs) for a pilot but burst prewarm requires coordination with capacity planning — expect 2w to provision and tune. Also need VPC peering and routing checklist.

raj: security: for HSM we need KMS review + attestation + SOC docs. That's ~2w for review + approvals if docs exist. Also require key lifecycle policy doc before we can enable customer HSM access.

priya: Product proposal: keep pilot narrow — prove latency/throughput with a single tenant, no customer-managed HSM initially; use Redwood-managed HSM for pilot to reduce risk. If that validates, fast-follow to customer HSM in a 'pilot+1' with a clear gating checklist. Thoughts?

mike: +1 to managed HSM to shorten time. We can implement managed-HSM adapter now and spin customer-HSM after pilot. Runtime effort still ~2w for adapter + tests if we scope to managed only.

sarah: That makes infra timeline easier — we can avoid per-tenant networking changes for the first pilot. Provisioning window becomes 1w.

elaine: Good. So current proposed v0 scope: dedicated reserved pool (3 GPUs), Redwood-managed HSM, limited telemetry (latency + token billing), single-customer SLA target. Defer customer-managed HSM, tenant isolation features, and long-term audit logs until post-pilot. Agree?

raj: Agree with defer, but we need a documented rollback plan and audit hooks enabled (even if logs are short-retention). I'll draft a short compliance checklist.

nate: Can we get a short doc with owners + milestone dates? I can schedule a 30m sync once we have owners.

elaine: Owners: mike -> runtime + adapter (owner), sarah -> infra provisioning & prewarm, raj -> security/compliance checklist, priya -> customer liaison & success criteria, nate -> launch coordination. Target milestones: prototype infra + runtime by 4999376000 (~1 week), internal pilot test by 4999500000 (~2 weeks), customer pilot kickoff by 4999800000 (~3.5 weeks). Is that realistic?

mike: Prototype runtime + managed-HSM adapter by 4999376000 - I can make that if we unblock infra. Need infra to confirm GPU carve.

sarah: I'll confirm provisioning by EOD tomorrow and create the capacity ticket. If accepted, we hit the prototype target.

priya: I'll prepare success criteria doc: throughput target (qps), p95 latency, error budget, and customer feedback checklist. Quick draft by 4998850000 (tomorrow afternoon).

raj: I'll post the compliance checklist draft by 4998900000. Need runtime to include simple KMS audit hook (headers) in responses.

deploy-bot: build-notify: infra/provisioning/terraform plan failed on staging — unknown provider version. See CI link: https://ci.internal/1234

mike: Noted, I'll triage the TF provider issue with eng-infra; might impact provisioning timeline by a day.

elaine: Action items summary: 1) mike: runtime + managed-HSM adapter (owner) 2) sarah: capacity carve + infra ticket 3) raj: compliance checklist + minimal audit hooks 4) priya: success criteria doc + customer comms 5) nate: schedule coordination sync. Let's reconvene once the prototype target (4999376000) is green.

elaine: Also attaching a minimal SLA snippet we can use for the pilot — drop into the success criteria doc:

```
service_sla:
  p95_latency: 150ms
  error_budget: 0.5%
  burst_multiplier: 3
  burst_window: 5m
```

mike: copy that into the PR template and I'll wire the metrics.

priya: thanks — I'll include those thresholds in the customer expectations email.

nate: scheduled 30m sync for 4999400000; invite sent to participants.

elaine: Cool. If anyone hits a blocker, ping here and mention blockers explicitly. :thumbsup:

mike: Will do.

sarah: FYI capacity ticket: https://infra/ops/6789 — added notes about burst prewarm configs.

raj: Uploaded compliance checklist draft: https://docs/internal/compliance/hsm-pilot-checklist.md

elaine: Thanks all — closing the loop for now.
